valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E at the 12-month target date, per ADR. SK hynix reports in KRW; 1 ADR (SKHY, Nasdaq) = 1/10 of a Seoul ordinary share (10 ADRs per share). FX: KRW 1,337.5 per USD, the Seoul close of 2026-11-10 (the latest dated rate found; the 2026-11-13 rate could not be sourced). Chain: FY2027 consolidated operating profit (KRW) x net-income conversion = net income; / FY2027 average ordinary shares = KRW EPS per share; / 1,337.5 / 10 = USD EPS per ADR; x P/E. Close of $131.79 per ADR = $1,317.90 per ordinary share = about KRW 1.76m. Share base: about 705m ordinary shares outstanding (aggregate data 7.05bn ADR-equivalents; about 729m issued less the 24.07m-share August buyback, cancellation pending). Dividends excluded (price-only). All FY2027 figures are my model assumptions; Q3 2026 results are preliminary and unaudited.

bear.driver: Memory down-cycle: FY2027 operating profit KRW 200tn (vs about KRW 269tn FY2026 = 9M actual KRW 181.5tn plus Q4 consensus KRW 87.3tn), net conversion 72%, 705m shares
bear.assumption: EPS KRW 204,255 per share = US$15.27 per ADR at 4x

base.driver: Q3/Q4 2026 run-rate (KRW 83.3tn and about 87tn per quarter) held roughly flat: FY2027 operating profit KRW 340tn, net conversion 75% (tax about 24%, no net non-operating loss), 690m average shares after buybacks
base.assumption: EPS KRW 369,565 per share = US$27.63 per ADR at 6x

bull.driver: HBM4/DRAM pricing and contracted volumes keep rising: FY2027 operating profit KRW 420tn, net conversion 76%, 680m shares
bull.assumption: EPS KRW 469,412 per share = US$35.10 per ADR at 7x

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS US$27.63 the US$131.79 close implies 4.8x. The unweighted mean of the five latest named targets (400, 250, 250, 220, 200 = US$264) implies 9.6x base EPS, or EPS of about US$44 at 6x (about 59% above the model).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by US$27.63 (21.0 pp of the close). A KRW 20tn change in FY2027 operating profit moves base EPS and target by about 5.9% (US$9.8).
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly DRAM/HBM average selling price change and operating margin (Q3 2026: revenue KRW 104.6tn, operating profit KRW 83.3tn, 80% margin), plus the non-operating line that cut Q3 net income to KRW 39.8tn
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release, expected late January 2027 (date not confirmed in sources)

analyst_notes: Named calls moved little in direction but widely in level since the Q3 print: Rosenblatt raised to $400 from $320 on 2026-10-28, while Cantor cut to $250 from $300 on 2026-10-26; Wolfe ($250), Needham ($220) and RBC ($200) sit in a $200-250 band, with Susquehanna Neutral. The base case of $165.79 is below every named target; the gap to the $264 mean is about 3 turns of P/E at base EPS (9.6x vs 6x) or about 59% more EPS at 6x. Several seats are unnamed or sourced from aggregators, no source documents a 12-month horizon so horizon is null and the sample stays out of the weighted target, and Needham's reported $235 and Barclays' $330 initiation could not be dated or confirmed.
